newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Comalco sees steady aluminium price.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Comalco sees steady aluminium price.

text.p: Aluminium producer Comalco Ltd said on Monday it expected aluminium prices to average between 68 and 70 U.S. cents per pound over the second half of calendar 1996.
Comalco chief executive Terry Palmer said in giving the forecast that he expected the market supply and demand for aluminium to come into balance over the second half of 1996 and into 1997.
Palmer quoted the aluminium price at 69 U.S. cents at the company's balance date on June 30 and a price of 67.5 cents at the close on the London Metal Exchange on Friday.
"I am not highly bullish about the price getting up this year," Palmer said.

Comalco, 70 percent owned by the RTZ Corp Plc-CRA Ltd, earlier announced a sharp drop in consolidated net profit for the six months to June 30 to A$59.5 million from A$157.1 million the previous corresponding half year.
